2608.27077.title: Learning Transverse Momentum Distributions from Raw Scattering Events via Conditional Diffusion
2608.27077.paper_summary: Extracting transverse momentum dependent parton distribution functions (TMD PDFs) from semi-inclusive deep inelastic scattering (SIDIS) data is a central goal of the nucleon structure program at Jefferson Lab and the future Electron-Ion Collider. Traditional extraction methods rely on parameterized functional forms and iterative fitting, which can limit the flexibility of the resulting distributions and make uncertainty quantification cumbersome. We present a conditional diffusion model that learns to map raw SIDIS event kinematics directly to TMD PDFs, bypassing explicit functional assumptions. Evaluated on simulated SIDIS data at CLAS12 kinematics, the model recovers the underlying TMD with informative uncertainties that narrow steadily with increasing event statistics, and produces reliable estimates even with as few as 1,000 conditioning events, a statistics-limited regime directly relevant to ongoing and planned experiments.
2608.27077.paper_summary_zh: 提取橫向動量依賴的部分子分佈函數（TMD PDFs）從半包容深非彈性散射（SIDIS）數據是傑佛遜實驗室及未來電子-離子對撞機核子構造計畫的核心目標。傳統的提取方法依賴於參數化的函數形式和迭代擬合，這可能限制了結果分佈的靈活性，並使不確定性量化變得繁瑣。我們提出了一種條件擴散模型，學習將原始SIDIS事件的運動學直接映射到TMD PDFs，繞過明確的函數假設。在CLAS12運動學的模擬SIDIS數據上進行評估時，該模型恢復了潛在的TMD，並提供了隨著事件統計量增加而穩步縮小的不確定性，即使在僅有1,000個條件事件的情況下，也能產生可靠的估計，這是一個與當前和計劃中的實驗直接相關的統計限制範疇。
